title: BookReader Pro
tagline: Advanced native Android eBook & document reader featuring real-time neural TTS, custom typography engine, and seamless offline storage
hero_description: My ongoing Android free to use project: a high-performance native novel reader with on-device neural TTS audio, quote-aware sentence chunking, persistent notification media bar, and offline audiobook synthesis.
tts_chunker_desc: SpeechSynthesisUtterance with custom speech rate and speed adjustments.
tts_unsupported: ⚠️ window.speechSynthesis is not supported in this browser.
showcase_subtitle: Explore BookReader's custom Jetpack Compose interface in its signature sepia reading theme, on-device neural TTS voice engines, and persistent background playback.
showcase_scroll_hint: Scroll or swipe to change screen
arch_layer_1_desc: Fully declarative Kotlin UI with Material Design 3 theming. Signature sepia/dark/light themes, bottom dock media controls, and full-width adaptive dialogs for settings.
arch_layer_2_desc: Decoupled MediaSessionService operating in an independent Android Service lifecycle. Survives orientation changes, app minimization, and handles audio focus for calls and navigation prompts.
arch_layer_3_desc: Multi-engine speech synthesis abstraction. Regex-based quote-aware tokenizer with quote protection, abbreviation shielding (Mr., Dr., Ch.), and CJK terminal character detection.
arch_layer_4_desc: Jsoup DOM pipeline for chapter extraction using user-configurable CSS selectors. JavascriptInterface bridge for userscript injection with wildcard URL matching.
arch_layer_5_desc: Crash-resistant persistence via Android AtomicFile (write → staging file → atomic rename). Thread-safe access with Coroutine Mutexes. Zero special permissions required.
arch_layer_6_desc: Decoupled domain, data, and presentation layers. StateFlow-driven reactive UI state, centralized AudioPlaybackCoordinator service, and Coroutine-based async operations.

home.title: Library & Playlist Hub
home.subtitle: NovelArrow Reader Pro · Root Folder & Scoped Storage
home.desc: Pick any root folder on your Android device. Every subfolder automatically becomes its own reading playlist with independently tracked chapter progression and offline text-to-speech audio state.

voice_engine.title: Neural Voice Engine
voice_engine.subtitle: On-Device AI Voices · Kokoro, Piper & KittenTTS
voice_engine.desc: Switch effortlessly between Android built-in Google TTS (474 voices) and cutting-edge on-device neural voice bundles. Experience natural human-grade prosody without any cloud subscriptions or privacy exposure.

toolbar_settings.title: Persistent Notification Media Bar
toolbar_settings.subtitle: AndroidX Media3 Foreground Service & Quick Controls
toolbar_settings.desc: A customized, quick-access reader bar pinned directly in your Android notification shade and lock screen. Keeps playback alive even after closing the app with battery optimization unrestricted.

audio_studio.title: Audio Studio & Audiobook Generator
audio_studio.subtitle: Offline Chapter Synthesis & Standalone MP3 Tracks
audio_studio.desc: Transform full web novel chapters into standalone MP3 audiobooks stored in local audio folders. Listen with the integrated chapter seekbar, speed adjustments (0.5×–2.5×), and background progress tracking.

live_web_tts.title: Live Web TTS & Reader
live_web_tts.subtitle: In-App Web Scraper & Article Audio Player
live_web_tts.desc: Integrated in-app browser with Jsoup DOM pipeline that strips ads, banners, and clutter from online novels and news sites. Streams clean extracted text straight into the live TTS audio player overlay.
